description: health_threshold=75 reuses the WATCH threshold already calibrated and live in calibration.json for this same LSTM model -- not a new invented number. consecutive_anomaly_threshold=6 (30 minutes) requires a sustained condition, not a single noisy sample, before treating it as meaningful.
validation_status: Threshold itself is reused/consistent with existing system. The FORECASTING MODEL used to project toward it (GRU) is validated by real backtested MAE/RMSE up to a 2-hour horizon only (see model_comparison.json) -- this is the longest horizon this machine's actual session lengths support with real training data. Any crossing projected beyond 2 hours out is an extrapolation beyond the validated range and is reported as such, not as a precise date.
